aboutMore: ok so apparently my about me is 'just bulletins.' more stuff. my little brother eli is 10 n thinks im the drummer (im not) (its bryan) n i havent corrected him bc he has a static prophecy sticker on his lunchbox n i dont wanna be the guy. i draw every night around 11 when the house is quiet, mostly the street out my window. my uncle stan has a tiny print shop (copies, flyers, 3 employees, 1 of them is stan) n he let me learn screen printing on the back table. so the shirts are real now. also my hair really is red. its a family thing. my moms is the same.

blog.title: merch table: the financials (some people asked)
blog.body: ok. static prophecy merch table, saturday. ITEMS: stickers, 50 cents (cost me 8 cents each, i did the math, nobody asked me to). buttons, $1 (library button maker, 10 per 20 min, the librarian watches me like im building a bomb). demo cd-r, $3 (greg burned 9. sold 6. 3 went to mothers). shirts, $10 (iron-on, my drawing, 12 made, 5 sold, 4 to family, 3 in my closet, i call that inventory). TOTAL: $43.50. COSTS: $31. PROFIT: $12.50. i spent it on a coke n a bag of chips for greg who said 'thx merch guy.' i said 'thx band guy.' nobody has ever called greg that. he went quiet n ate the chips in the garage like a man who just got a medal. the band made $0. the merch table made $12.50. i dont wanna say who is really in the band. i just think everyone should look at the spreadsheet. (its a notebook page. its a spreadsheet.)

blog.title: i made a screen (the shirts are real now) (the iron-on era is over)
blog.body: ok so the iron-on shirts peel at the collar after 2 washes. everybody knows. greg's mom said 'honey, they're coming apart.' so my uncle stan, who owns a print shop, said 'u wanna learn a real way.' we built a screen on the back table. an embroidery hoop, a piece of sheer curtain (stan said it was 'from a closet, nobody will miss it'), a bottle of photo emulsion ($14), and a desk lamp w/ a 150 watt bulb. u coat the curtain, u dry it in a closet in the dark like a vampire, u put my drawing on top (printed on clear plastic), u hit it w/ the lamp for 40 min, then u wash it out in the sink n the drawing is just. there. a hole in the shape of the lightning bolt. the first pull came out backwards. the second came out crooked. the 3rd was perfect. i printed 6 shirts. greg held one up in the garage w/ both hands like it was a fish. he said 'this doesnt peel.' i said 'its a real print.' he said 'u made a shirt that doesnt peel.' that is the whole review. i'll take it.

blog.title: 3 am (a field guide)
blog.body: things that happen on my street between 3:00 and 3:30. 3:02 - the neighbors sprinkler turns on. it goes tsk tsk tsk. i like it. 3:05 - the gas station on the corner, which is 24 hrs, makes the whole sky a little orange. 3:10 - a car w/ one headlight goes by. its the same one every night. i think its a guy who works nights somewhere. i draw him as a ghost. 3:12 - a possum comes thru the yard. fence, bush, trash can, back. i call him bert (bert mccracken, obviously). he has never deviated. i respect that. 3:20 - aqua teen on, volume 2. 3:30 - eli's night light in the hall makes a small yellow shape on the floor outside my door. thats the best part. some people say 3 am is for thinking. its also for cereal. i do both. i draw all of it in my sketchbook. its not sad. its quiet. i like quiet. dont make it a bulletin. (i made it a blog.)

blog.title: my brother took over the merch table (he is 10) (he is better than me)
blog.body: eli came to the show saturday bc mom had a thing. he sat down at the merch table before i could stop him. he put on the band sticker like a badge. he rearranged the buttons by color. then a man who was like 40 came over n eli said 'sir, that's 50 cents.' the man gave him $2 n said keep it. eli put it in the cash box, wrote it down on his hand, n gave the man 3 stickers. i asked why. he said 'bc he was nice.' eli sold 11 stickers, 4 buttons, n a cd-r to a lady who said she was greg's neighbor. she said 'please make it quieter.' eli said 'we're working on it, ma'am.' later he asked, 'is the band famous yet.' i said no. he said 'ok. when.' like it was a bus schedule. i said soon. he said 'ok, ill hold the table.' i dont know what to do w/ that. im being outsold by a fifth grader n i have never been prouder. he still thinks im the drummer. i'm not telling him.

survey.title: the 'artist survey' from an art forum (2am, answered in pen)
qa: what do you draw:
myself, mostly. the street out my window. a possum. my brother as a superhero in shutter shades. he didnt ask why
what do you use:
a 0.5 mechanical pencil, a black pilot pen, n a sketchbook w/ a hoodie string for a bookmark
favorite thing you ever drew:
my default. its me if i was cooler. thats the whole point of drawing yourself
do you take commissions:
mika opened art trade slots n i asked first. so yes. ill draw shutter shades on anything. u cant stop me
worst thing about being an artist:
ppl ask u to draw their name in bubble letters at a party n then dont say anything n just look at it
best thing about being an artist:
someone at a show goes 'who drew that shirt' n u say 'me' n u just stand there for a second
something u built:
a screen for printing shirts. an embroidery hoop, my moms old curtain, a lamp. it works. i didnt tell the lamp
something u are bad at:
texting back. also finishing sentences. also saying out loud what i drew. i just put it in the sketchbook n turn the page
who knows u best:
my brother. he's 10. he notices everything n says it in the car
last thing u erased:
a drawing of a person i wasnt gonna show. i erased it. i drew a tree. the tree is fine
best sound in the world:
an amp when its working. just a hum. a clean hum. u can hear it breathe
something u would never say out loud:
sometimes i draw lexi n then i dont show anyone. i keep those in the back of the sketchbook. i'm not saying more

dms: uncle stan called. he asked what i charge for a shirt. i said $10. he said 'charge 15. 20 for two.' i said why. he said 'bc people think ur lying if its 10.' i said 'thats not how that works.' he said 'thats exactly how it works.' i raised it. ive sold 4. he was right. i hate that he was right

eli found the back pages of my sketchbook. he said 'who's that.' it was lexi. i said 'a girl.' he said 'is she nice.' i said yeah. he said 'ok. put her on the fridge.' i said no. he said 'ok.' he has a gift for knowing when to say ok. i wish i had it

bert (the possum) didnt show at 3:12 tonight. its 3:19. im not worried. im just at the window. hes never been late. ok hes here. he took a different route. he went AROUND the bush. i have so many questions. i respect his growth

went back to hot topic. not for a coupon. i told holly the merch table does 15 for a shirt, 20 for two. she said she'd buy two. i said 'u dont have to.' she said 'i know.' she bought two. one is on her at work. one is in a drawer by the register next to my expired coupon. i dont know what is happening
